## Incident Overview

In `_phase_resolve_threads`, batch resolution failures via `_pr_resolve_thread "$_ct" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true` silently swallow errors. Network errors or GraphQL failures during resolveReviewThread mutations are indistinguishable from successful resolutions in the log.

## Source

CI llm-review iteration 8 finding [4] on PR #37 (job 74100719710). Classified IMPORTANT by reviewer; downgraded to MINOR after analysis — fail-open here is intentional (next polling iteration re-fetches and retries naturally), but the lack of any log signal hides legitimate retryable conditions.

## Suggested Fix

Capture per-thread exit codes; emit `WARN: thread $_ct resolution failed (rc=$rc)` on non-zero so operators can distinguish silent retry from genuine progress.
